title: Minestroyer
description: This mod adds 13 more bosses to Minecraft.
body: This is a Minecraft boss mod that adds 13 more bosses. This is a good mod either for people who like boss mods, an OP sword or nukes in minecraft! List of current bosses: Keeper Draco you can find it's spawn egg in the chest on the roof of draco's dungeon, Which generates in any biome on the surface in the overworld. Mutated Bat You can craft it's spawn egg using bat wings (which drop from bats) and an amethyst shard. Groundes Dragon You can find it's spawn egg in dirt houses that generate in grassy biomes in the overworld. Drops a ground plant when killed. Gooplicater You can craft it's spawn egg. Duplicates itself after every 40 seconds. Freeze Monster Found in freezing fortresses which generate in icy biomes such as the ice spikes. Prismarine Golem Found in Ocean Temples that generates in deep oceans, In the main chest. Wind Fish You can craft it's spawn egg using breeze related items and a raw cod. Obsidian Golem It's spawn egg is crafted using a Strength Energy Crystal and nether related items. Nature Titan Right-Click a Nature Monolith with a Fire Charge. Shoots poison leaves and explosive dirt chunks. Honey Assimilator Can be found in Honey Houses which generates underground. Shoots honey bottles which make a honey mess on impact with a block. Scorcheye It's spawn egg can be crafted and it will shoot fireballs. Warped Terminator It's spawn egg can either be crafted or found in the Heart of The Warped Forest. Shoots laser orbs. Crimson Serpent It's spawn egg can either be crafted or found in the Heart of The Crimson Forest. Shoots fireballs all over the place.
